description: This file contains functions to seed a database with predefined roles, skills, and their relationships for a career pathway navigator backend. It defines data models, repository interactions, and seeding logic, including idempotent operations to ensure consistent state.

classes.name: Skill
classes.description: Represents a skill entity in the database.

classes.name: Role
classes.description: Represents a role entity in the database.

classes.name: SkillRepository
classes.description: Repository class for skill-related database operations.

classes.name: RoleRepository
classes.description: Repository class for role-related database operations.

classes.name: ProgressRepository
classes.description: Repository class for user progress tracking.

methods.name: List[Skill] _ensure_skills(skill_repo: SkillRepository, specs: List[Tuple[str, str, str]])
methods.description: Creates or fetches skills from the database based on provided specifications.

methods.name: None _attach_role_skills( role_repo: RoleRepository, rec_repo: RecommendationRepository, role_name: str, role_skill_levels: Dict[str, int], )
methods.description: Attaches specified skills with levels to a role, avoiding duplicates, and adds optional guidance recommendations.

methods.name: None seed_minimal_dataset(session: Session)
methods.description: Seeds the database with a minimal baseline dataset of roles and skills, establishing core relationships.

methods.name: None seed_minimal_dataset_idempotent(session: Session)
methods.description: Performs an idempotent seed, ensuring roles, skills, and links exist without duplication; safe for repeated execution.

ctags.name: _attach_role_skills
ctags.signature: ( role_repo: RoleRepository, rec_repo: RecommendationRepository, role_name: str, role_skill_levels: Dict[str, int], )

ctags.name: _ensure_skills
ctags.pattern: /^def _ensure_skills(skill_repo: SkillRepository, specs: List[Tuple[str, str, str]]) -> List[Skill/
